description: This file contains makefile instructions and macros related to managing patches and patches directories for building Linux kernels and packages, specifically using quilt. It defines multiple macros for patch handling, directory setup, and quilt refresh operations, with conditional logic based on build environment variables.

methods.name: filter_series
methods.description: A macro to filter the series file, removing comments and non-alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: PatchDir/Quilt
methods.description: A macro to prepare and copy quilt patches from one directory to another, handling series files and subdirs.

methods.name: PatchDir/Default
methods.description: A macro to apply patches from a directory to a target directory, respecting quilt configurations.

methods.name: PatchDir
methods.description: A macro that calls either Quilt or Default patch directory handling based on quilt usage.

methods.name: HostPatchDir
methods.description: A macro similar to PatchDir, but specifically for host build patches.

methods.name: Host/Patch/Default
methods.description: A macro to set up host patches directory and touch quilt usage marker.

methods.name: Build/Patch/Default
methods.description: A macro to set up package patches directory and mark quilt usage.

methods.name: Kernel/Patch/Default
methods.description: A macro to handle applying patches for the Linux kernel, including copying generic patches, and cleaning up rejects and backup files.

methods.name: Quilt/RefreshDir
methods.description: A macro to refresh a quilt patches directory from its series file, optionally filtered.

methods.name: Quilt/Refresh/Host
methods.description: A macro to refresh host patches directory.

methods.name: Quilt/Refresh/Package
methods.description: A macro to refresh package patches directory.

methods.name: Quilt/Refresh/Kernel
methods.description: A macro to refresh kernel patches, ensuring patches start with correct prefixes.

methods.name: Quilt/Template
methods.description: A macro that creates build targets for quilt patch management, including configuration checks, series validation, quilt push/pop, and refresh commands.
